# __PKG__

> __DESC_EN__

## Install

    dsh plugin --profile <profile> add __PKG__

## Verify

    dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config | grep -A2 "id: __PLUGIN_ID__"

## Develop

    pnpm install
    pnpm verify
